text.tspan: Pre-configured trust anchor:\nroot KSK public key (RFC 5011)
Chain validated — set AD flag.\nAny break → SERVFAIL + EDE 6 (Bogus)

svg.text: root DNSKEY + RRSIG (signed by root KSK)
Verify root DNSKEY against trust anchor
DS com. + RRSIG (signed by root ZSK)
com DNSKEY + RRSIG (signed by com KSK)
Verify com KSK hash matches root's DS for com
DS example.com + RRSIG (signed by com ZSK)
example.com DNSKEY + RRSIG (signed by zone KSK)
Verify zone KSK hash matches com's DS
A RRset + RRSIG (signed by zone ZSK)
Verify A RRset signature with zone ZSK
